result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners, controlled by traffic signals. However, the lack of curb extensions and the presence of parked vehicles near the crossing points create potential visibility issues and increase pedestrian exposure distance.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side of the image may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the right side of the street beyond the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears to allow for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve visibility between all road users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

result.summary: The street features a wide multi-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. However, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of signalization or traffic calming measures create a moderately high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway exposes pedestrians to traffic for a significant duration without a signalized break.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the entire road width

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the crosswalk entrance can hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street adjacent to the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Activated Warning Signal
interventions.description: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB) to alert drivers when a pedestrian is crossing.

result.summary: The intersection provides essential pedestrian infrastructure, including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is a mixed-use area with continuous sidewalks, though the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near the corners present visibility and exposure risks.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near intersection
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers, particularly at the corners.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the cross street.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without the protection of a median or refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
